title: experiment-runway-and-artifact-lineage-for-cross-cycle-rollouts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: Define a repeatable 'experiment runway' pattern that maps experiments to OKRs across release cycles, ensures artifact lineage (design specs, hypothesis docs, eval datasets, PRs, dashboards), and standardizes handoffs between PM, Eng, and Design. Goals: 1) reduce lost context during multi-cycle experiments; 2) provide clear gating checkpoints tied to OKR success criteria; 3) make dependencies and rollback triggers explicit in the ticket. Acceptance criteria: - Runway template published in Confluence with required artifact checklist and example mapping to an OKR; - Experiment tagging policy implemented for Linear and Console dashboards; - 3 pilot experiments onboarded and passed runway review; - Observable SLOs and guardrail metrics wired to the experiment dashboard. Links: Confluence:/drive/projects/exp-runway (hypothesis templates), Drive:/sheets/exp-runway-tracker, GitHub PRs: TBD, Dashboards: analytics.redwood/exp-runway (placeholder).
